edits.current: Pension income paid BY THE EMPLOYER: pensions of jubilacion, vejez or invalidez (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). Taxable only above 1,000 UVT per month (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5. Pensions paid directly by the employer are in scope and are certified here. SOURCE: the pension wage types of the wage-type-to-casilla table: 62154 Monthly Retired  Pension-6798 (the monthly pension) and 62153 Additional Retirement Pension (the additional pension instalments paid in June and December). Payments to retirees that are not a pension are certified in casilla 46, never here: 62151 Retirement Payment - PRV-6795, 62152 Retirement Payment - Catleya-6796, 62115 Retirement Allowance, 62830 Pensioner Allowance-6794 and 62155 Medical Plan - Healthcare Insurance (EPS ) Pensioner- PMI Offset Compensation (see casilla 46). Pension payees are not in the employee master: their identification (casillas 24-29) comes from the pensioner master (see casilla 25). SURVIVOR OR SUBSTITUTE PENSION: where the pension is paid to a beneficiary other than the original pensioner (substitute pensioner or other recipient), the certificate is issued in the name of the person who receives the pension - that person's document type, number and names in casillas 24-29 and the pension received in casilla 50; the same identity rule applies to the Format 2276 record of that payee. Pensioner health and solidarity deductions (21645 / 21646 / 21647, 21643) feed casillas 53 and 54, and the withholding on pension income (21140 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799) feeds casilla 60.
